 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Carson Hocevar's name has dominated NASCAR headlines for all the wrong reasons lately. Dale Earnhardt Jr. just gave fans something entirely different to talk about.
 During a live appearance of his popular "Dale Jr. Download" podcast , Earnhardt revealed plans to put Hocevar behind the wheel of a JR Motorsports car next year.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The announcement was met with an enthusiastic reaction from the crowd, a notable response considering the controversy surrounding Hocevar's recent suspension.
 "We're gonna get Hocevar to race one of our (JRM) cars next year," Earnhardt said.
 Dirty Mo Media shared the moment on social media Nov. 9, adding that the "whole crowd went wild."
 https://twitter.com/DirtyMoMedia/status/2119840760199786620
 Dale Earnhardt Jr. Reveals Plans for Carson Hocevar at JR Motorsports
 Earnhardt's announcement raises an intriguing possibility for Hocevar, whose aggressive driving style has made him one of NASCAR's most talked-about young competitors.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Spire Motorsports driver has never been particularly shy about racing hard, even when it means upsetting the competition. His willingness to take chances has attracted attention, but it has also created problems.
 Most recently, Hocevar was suspended by Spire for the 2026 Cup Series championship race at Homestead-Miami Speedway following an incident involving Austin Cindric at Martinsville.
 NASCAR also fined Hocevar $100,000 and deducted 25 championship points.
 The disciplinary action brought an abrupt end to his Cup Series season, leaving plenty of questions about how he would respond heading into 2027.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Now, Earnhardt has introduced an unexpected development.
 JR Motorsports has long been one of the most competitive organizations in NASCAR's second-tier national series, making the prospect of Hocevar driving one of its cars particularly interesting.
 Earnhardt did not specify which race Hocevar would enter, what car he would drive or whether the appearance would be a one-off opportunity or part of a larger schedule.
 Those details remain unannounced.
 What Dale Earnhardt Jr.'s Announcement Means for Hocevar
 For Hocevar, the opportunity could provide a chance to put the conversation back where he would undoubtedly prefer it: on his driving.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The young driver has shown speed throughout his NASCAR career, but his reputation for aggressive racing has increasingly become part of the discussion surrounding him.
 That makes Earnhardt's willingness to put him in a JR Motorsports car especially noteworthy.
 Earnhardt has spent years developing young talent through his racing organization. He also knows better than most what it means to compete under intense scrutiny, particularly when a driver's decisions become bigger headlines than his results.
 Whether the proposed appearance becomes an opportunity for Hocevar to make a statement on the track remains to be seen.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For now, there is no confirmed race date or additional information about the arrangement.
 But one thing was immediately clear from the reaction to Earnhardt's announcement: NASCAR fans are already interested in seeing what happens when Hocevar gets his chance.
